setting.name: AAAH! Accidentally Anthropomorphic Animal Heroes
setting.tagline: Talking-animal vigilantes fight crime in New Bristol
setting.blurb: It's the year Twenty Something and Something, and MOON LABS, New Bristol's foremost scientific research facility, has accidentally created a team of anthropomorphic animals, who promptly escaped and disappeared into the city. From time to time these animal heroes pop up to save the day, much to the chagrin of the overworked New Bristol Police Department who have yet to catch these menacing vigilantes. But gangs of talking animals led by the archvillain Whistler terrorize the streets, and he has a new nefarious plan to control the whole world using his fearsome psionic powers. You play a heroic talking animal—a ninja turtle, a mouse detective, or even a kung-fu dog.
rules: Two Roles: instead of a Trait and one Role, each Hero has an Origin, a Trait, and two Roles—one animal Role and one occupation Role (from the core lists). You get the benefits of both Roles and can arrange them in any order (cat doctor, doctor cat).

Roll your animal: you don't choose your animal Role, you roll d66 on the New Animal Roles table (Ape 11 … Velociraptor 66). A combined d66 table also lets you roll Trait, Origin, and Occupation randomly.

Your Origin: roll d66 for an Origin (Atomic, Mutant, Radioactive, Cybernetic, Magical, Clone, Psychic, Demonic, etc.). It grants no abilities—it just sounds cool. All the Heroes should share the same Origin, since that is why they are together.
Descriptor: form it as Trait + Origin + two Roles in any order, e.g. Angry Chemical Frog Detective or Teenage Psychic Cowboy Dog.

Your Base: the team shares one base. One Hero rolls a die: 1 the sewers (pop out of manhole covers), 2 a cave under City Hall, 3 exhibits at the zoo who sneak out at night, 4 a big mansion, 5 an amusement park, 6 a top-secret military experimental base that sends you on missions.

Legal Status: roll a die for why the Heroes are Wanted (1 vigilantes not welcome, 2 framed for a crime, 3 government wants to study them, 4 corrupt police department, 5 messed up a previous case, 6 actually committed a crime). Whatever the result, the Heroes are wanted by the law and must stay clear of cops.

Gathering Info: roll a die for the team's contact (1 ace reporter, 2 a cop—roll again, on a 6 it's the Commissioner, 3 someone at the mayor's office, 4 a hacker, 5 a shadowy figure in dark alleyways, 6 a network of street spies). The contact never rats on the Heroes. When the Heroes need a vital piece of information, one of them spends 1 Karma to ask the contact.

Random Crime Generator: roll 2 dice for the crime (2 Hostages, 3 Arson, 4 Brawling, 5 Mugging, 6 Shoplifting, 7 Robbery, 8 Vandalism, 9 Speeding/Dangerous Driving, 10 Drunk & Disorderly, 11 Murder, 12 Kidnap) and 2 dice for the location (2 Avocado Inc., 3 Bingo Pizzas, 4 NBTV Studios, 5 First Bristol Bank, 6 Central Botanic Gardens, 7 City Streets—roll d6: highway/alleyway/plaza/shopping mall/bar/residential, 8 New Bristol University, 9 World State Tower, 10 Oliver Peabeard Library, 11 MOON LABS, 12 Museum of Natural Art). The crime is perpetrated by one mook per Hero.

Getting About Town: to have a vehicle, flash back to buying it—spend a Karma and make a Style roll: 5 bicycle/skateboard/roller skates, 10 cheap car or van, 20 decent car, bike or van like The A-Team, 30 luxury James Bond vehicle with a trick or two, 40 a supercar like Knight Rider or Dangermouse. Otherwise the Heroes are on foot.

Run Some Red Lights: when racing across the city, roll a die for an obstacle—1 Roadworks (driver Smarts 10 for a better route), 2 Flatbed truck (Moves 10 to swerve), 3 Sheet of glass (Smarts 10 to spot it or pay damages later), 4 Fruit cart (Moves 10 to smash through or 15 to swerve clear), 5 Wetworks (Smarts 10 to route around or Moves 15 to gun it over wet concrete; failure gets the car stuck), 6 Nuns! (Moves 15 to swerve). Sewer travel gets different hazards—fatbergs, gas clouds, slime.
Mooks in New Bristol are ordinary humans unless the Director says otherwise; only the major players are talking animals. Mook gangs are always one mook per Hero.
Handcuffs hold anyone unless they make a Moves or Brawn 20 roll; ninja weapons (sword, staff, sai, nunchaku) do 3 damage; an Uzi does 4 damage; pizza restores 1 Health.

roles.name: Ape
roles.ability: You're a walking, talking ape! You can jump 30 feet in the air with no effort. Also, when you throw things, you do an extra point of damage!

roles.name: Badger
roles.ability: Badgers are fierce and super angry. You regain +1 Karma every time you do melee damage in a fight.

roles.name: Bat
roles.ability: You can fly, and you can use your echolocation to see in the dark. And you're pretty good at hiding, getting +1 die when you try to be stealthy.

roles.name: Bear
roles.ability: You're big and tough and kinda cuddly. You get +3 Health.

roles.name: Cat
roles.ability: Agile and sneaky though you are, your main power is your nine lives! Roll a die; that's how many lives you have left. When you would normally be Knocked Out, instead you remain at 1 Health.

roles.name: Crocodile
roles.ability: Those big snapping teeth do 3 damage. Ouchy!

roles.name: Crow
roles.ability: You can fly. You don't have to be a crow; you can pick a different bird if you want.

roles.name: Dog
roles.ability: A loyal companion, if there's something to smell you can always smell it. Also, sometimes you smell, and you like fetching things. Good dog!

roles.name: Donkey
roles.ability: Stubborn as a mule. You cannot be mind controlled or mentally influenced in any way.

roles.name: Duck
roles.ability: Ducks can swim and fly and quack. Some of these things are more useful than others.

roles.name: Elephant
roles.ability: Elephants never forget. You can produce random useful pieces of knowledge from the recesses of your mind. Simply ask the Director, spend 1 Karma, and they'll tell you something super useful. Oh, also you get +1 Brawn.

roles.name: Fox
roles.ability: You are oh so cunning! You'd make a great detective… or a great criminal! You get +2 Karma and your Smarts score increases by 1.

roles.name: Frog
roles.ability: Bouncing and jumping all over the place with ease! You can scale great heights with your prodigious leap—heights and distances of up to 60 feet. You also have a sticky tongue which lets you grab things from about 15 feet away.

roles.name: Hamster
roles.ability: Hamsters store stuff in their cheeks. You can spend 1 Karma and automatically pull out an item with a target number of 10 or less.

roles.name: Hippo
roles.ability: Hippos are the most dangerous animal in the world, and super territorial. If anybody comes within 10 feet of you, you have to make a Smarts 10 check to avoid bopping them (making a melee attack).

roles.name: Jackal
roles.ability: Jackals are wily scavengers, which makes you really good at finding things. If you're looking for something and it's within 10 feet of you, you find it.

roles.name: Kangaroo
roles.ability: Kangaroos pack one heck of a punch! Your punch does an extra point of damage. Most people try to ignore the boxing gloves.

roles.name: Lion
roles.ability: You can roar really loudly. Make a Style check vs. the Style of anybody (except your friends) within sight who can hear you. Anybody you beat becomes afraid and cannot approach you for one minute.

roles.name: Lizard
roles.ability: You can change color. That makes it easy to hide, giving you a +1 die when you do, but it also makes you very stylish, giving you +1 Style.

roles.name: Mole
roles.ability: You are very shortsighted and take a penalty of -1 die to ranged attacks, but you can dig! You can dig underground and move through the earth, under walls, and emerge wherever you wish.

roles.name: Monkey
roles.ability: You can climb, you can swing. As long as you are in an area with enough things to grab on, you are effectively able to fly. Plus, you get +2 Defence.

roles.name: Mouse
roles.ability: You are a master of stealth. You'd make a great secret agent! When you sneak you get an extra two dice to roll.

roles.name: Ostrich
roles.ability: You can ignore things, and when you ignore things they don't exist for you. You can designate a creature or object and choose to ignore it. That creature or object is unable to affect you, but you are unable to affect it. It's like it simply isn't there.

roles.name: Owl
roles.ability: Owls are wise and perceptive. You can see in the dark, and also you can fly. And you can swivel your head round.

roles.name: Pig
roles.ability: Pigs can eat anything. You gain 1 Health by spending a minute eating. Doesn't matter what.

roles.name: Platypus
roles.ability: You're such a ridiculous animal that everybody does a double take when they see you. You can make a Style vs. Smarts roll against a target nearby, and if you win they spend the next round gawping in bewilderment.

roles.name: Porcupine
roles.ability: You're covered in spiky quills. Whenever somebody makes a melee attack against you they automatically take 1 damage.

roles.name: Rabbit
roles.ability: You are great at running away. In any situation, as long as you're not trapped or restrained, you can run away easily.

roles.name: Rat
roles.ability: Rats can chew through anything. It takes you a minute, but you can bite through any restraints, and in an hour you can chew through a door.

roles.name: Rhino
roles.ability: When you charge at somebody within 30 feet, you deal double damage with any melee attack. If they're your size or smaller, you also knock them down.

roles.name: Skunk
roles.ability: You can emit a horrible smell. Anybody nearby (yes, that includes your friends!) must make a Brawn 15 roll or spend the next turn doubled over in disgust.

roles.name: Snake
roles.ability: You can sway back and forth and hypnotize your prey. Make a Style vs. Smarts roll. If you win, your target will do one thing you say, but they won't harm themselves. Then you can't hypnotize that target again.

roles.name: Squirrel
roles.ability: With your big bushy tail, you're so cute! You can run up trees to escape from dogs and supervillains alike. Also, you like nuts.

roles.name: Tiger
roles.ability: You're big and fierce, and everybody knows not to mess with you. You get +1 die when you attack and you do +1 damage with any melee attack. Rawwr!

roles.name: Turtle
roles.ability: A hero in a half shell, you reduce all damage done to you by 1 point.

roles.name: Velociraptor
roles.ability: You live to hunt your prey—spend a Karma point to designate a prey that you can see. You get an extra die with any rolls against that target, but you cannot switch to a new prey until that target is reduced to 0 Health or a day has passed.

gear.name: Beachball
gear.description: It's a beachball. What?

gear.name: Earplugs
gear.description: Useful if you don't want to hear somebody whistling.

gear.name: Handcuffs
gear.description: Snap these on somebody, and they won't be able to break free unless they make a Moves or Brawn 20 roll.

gear.name: Parachute
gear.description: Ensures you take no damage when you fall, as long as you fall 10 stories or more.

gear.name: Pizza
gear.description: Mmmm. Delicious pizza. Pizza restores 1 Health. And they deliver it.

gear.name: Caltrops
gear.description: Medium (15). Throw some of these spiky bad boys down to slow somebody: they'll have to spend a turn making their way over them or take a point of damage.

gear.name: Ninja sword
gear.description: Medium (15). Or any kind of sword, really. Does 3 damage.

gear.name: Ninja weapons (staff, sai, nunchaku)
gear.description: Medium (15). Other ninja weapons of your choice. Ninja weapons do 3 damage.

gear.name: Jetpack
gear.description: No wings? No problem! Spend 1 Karma to fly for a turn.

gear.name: Radar
gear.description: If your opponents are flying, use this radar to give yourself and all your allies +1 die to shoot them.

gear.name: Rocket skates
gear.description: This footwear adds +1 to your Moves score. And it looks really rad.

gear.name: Skeleton key
gear.description: This thing will open any lock. But each time you use it, roll a die. If you roll a 1, it breaks.

gear.name: Umbrella shield
gear.description: When open, this umbrella acts like a shield. Attackers suffer a -1 die penalty when trying to hit you.

gear.name: Uzi
gear.description: A submachine gun always comes in handy, and you can pretend you're The Terminator. This Uzi 9mm does 4 damage.

gear.name: X-ray Specs
gear.description: These glasses let you see through walls and stuff. Also comes as an eyepatch.

gear.name: Bicycle, skateboard, or roller skates
gear.description: Getting About Town: spend a Karma and make a Style roll of 5 in a flashback to when somebody bought it.

gear.name: Cheap car or van
gear.description: A cheap car or van which may or may not fall apart. Spend a Karma and make a Style 10 roll.

gear.name: Decent car, bike, or van
gear.description: A decent car, bike, or van like The A-Team. Spend a Karma and make a Style 20 roll.

gear.name: Luxury vehicle
gear.description: A luxury vehicle like James Bond has; might have a trick or two. Spend a Karma and make a Style 30 roll.

gear.name: Supercar
gear.description: Some kind of supercar or something like out of Knight Rider or Dangermouse (or a helicopter). Spend a Karma and make a Style 40 roll.

extras.name: Banjo
extras.description: Tough but dumb rhino henchman. Leads the Whistler's warthog mooks in the Museum of Natural Art robbery.

extras.name: Jerry
notes: Jerry can leap heights and distances of up to 60 feet.
He has a sticky tongue which lets him grab things from about 15 feet away.
extras.description: Greedy frog henchman. Raids the safety deposit boxes at First Bristol Bank with wolf mooks armed with tommy guns.

extras.name: Sliver
notes: Sliver can chew through anything. It takes him a minute to chew through restraints and an hour to chew through a door.
extras.description: Clever rat henchman. Leads four turtle ninja mooks (Mikey, Leo, Donny, and Ralph) in the NBTV Studios robbery.

extras.name: Roller Coaster Cart
notes: When reduced to 0 Health, the cart crashes off the roller coaster, leaving its occupants bruised and dazed with 0 Health.

Each turn of the chase, roll a die: 1 Upside down loop (Moves 10 or fall off for 1 damage); 2 Tunnel (a 1 on the Calamity Die with a ranged attack hits an ally); 3 Jump (Moves 10 or drop what is held); 4 Corkscrew (Style 15 or miss the turn); 5-6 Fork (melee attacks possible this turn).
extras.description: Sliver's cart on the NBTV soundstage roller coaster; Heroes may target the cart instead of the occupants.

extras.name: Velociraptor
notes: When attacking in a group of 3 or more velociraptors, each gains +1 die to attacks.
extras.description: Experimental velociraptors loose in MOON LABS. They're mad and will attack anybody and everybody, including the Heroes.

extras.name: Giant Spider

attacks.name: Sticky Web
attacks.note: 30-foot range, restrains target, needs Brawn 10 check to escape

extras.description: A pair of giant spiders lair in the cargo hold of the buried Viking ship Ormurin Langi.

extras.name: Crow Mobster
notes: If two of the three are defeated, the third flees.
extras.description: Trilby-wearing crow mobsters staking out Rocky Rocco's apartment building over his gambling debts.

extras.name: Tango
extras.description: Fierce but loyal tiger henchman. Guards the 1st floor foyer of the World State Tower with his mooks.

extras.name: Burt
extras.description: Really a nice bear underneath. Guards the 35th floor maintenance level of the World State Tower with his mooks.

extras.name: Jacko
extras.description: Sly, mean-spirited jackal henchman. Guards the 86th floor observatory of the World State Tower with his mooks.

extras.name: Whistler

attacks.name: Bite
attacks.note: target is poisoned, losing 1 more Health on their next turn

notes: Whistle. The Whistler makes a Power vs Smarts check against a target within sight who can hear him. If he succeeds, that target will do anything he says for 1 minute.
Not much of a physical threat; he will try to turn the strongest Hero against their allies.
extras.description: Sinister evil snake genius—a hooded cobra who can control the weak-minded by whistling. Archvillain of New Bristol, hiding out on the 100th floor top deck of the World State Tower with his ninja guard.

extras.name: Ninja
extras.description: The Whistler's personal guard of ninjas (one for each Hero) on the top deck of the World State Tower.
